integrity: The primary preprint was inspected at Definition 2.2, the standard hyperjump facts, Theorem 2.3 and its proof, and the conclusion. The low-side induction uses a proved lemma omega_1^{Y'}=omega_1^Y; the high-side induction uses source-stated hyperjump monotonicity under hyperarithmetic reducibility and the fact that the hyperjump computes its oracle.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite iteration and Turing degrees only. It supplies no limit-stage definition, no transfinite hierarchy, and no equality of canonical representatives. It is a structural consequence of the one-step Gap Theorem plus the standard preservation of the relativized Church--Kleene ordinal under finite Turing jump.
title: Finite iteration of the gap pseudo-hyperjump splits into jump and hyperjump towers
